episodes.title: Chapter 1: Homecoming
episodes.summary: A woman missing for seven years turns up at a hospital with strange scars on her back but can't -- or won't -- reveal where she's been.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: New Colossus
episodes.summary: The OA retraces the dramatic twists and turns in her life after a childhood accident, leading up to a fateful encounter far from home many years later.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: Champion
episodes.summary: A journalist approaches the family with an offer. At Hap's, a bond is forged with Homer and the others as they hatch a desperate plan.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: Away
episodes.summary: An agonizing dilemma gives OA a new perspective on the group's plight. Homer resolves to find out what Hap's experiments are really about.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: Paradise
episodes.summary: While Hap zeroes in on a new test subject in Cuba, Homer and OA work to perfect their escape plan. Scott reaches his breaking point.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: Forking Paths
episodes.summary: As the group continues its search for the final movement, a startling turn of events gives Hap's work a new urgency.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Empire of Light
episodes.summary: An ominous new dream and a tense outing with Nancy and Abel take a toll on OA. Steve finds his life in turmoil once again.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: Invisible Self
episodes.summary: After OA recounts a dramatic final night at Hap's, the others begin to see her story in a new light. The fragments of the dream click into place.

episodes.title: Chapter 1: Angel of Death
episodes.summary: While private eye Karim Washington scours San Francisco for a missing teen who was involved in a cryptic game, OA wakes up in unfamiliar surroundings.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: Treasure Island
episodes.summary: At the clinic, OA discovers what happened to her friends back at Hap's. Karim turns his attention to a doctor who worked for Pierre Ruskin.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: Magic Mirror
episodes.summary: In Michigan, Steve begs the gang to try jumping to another dimension, and a presence in Buck's mirror inspires an unlikely pilgrimage.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: SYZYGY
episodes.summary: Karim visits Nina at the clinic for help finding the secret entrance to the house. Meanwhile, Hap meets a fellow traveler, and Homer goes on a date.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: The Medium & the Engineer
episodes.summary: After a harrowing ordeal, OA and Karim find themselves locked inside a labyrinth of puzzles. Nagging doubts prompt Homer to snoop on Dr. Percy.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: Mirror Mirror
episodes.summary: As BBA and the kids head west, an alarming news report forces them to speed up their plans. Jesse wrestles with lingering trauma from the shooting.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Nina Azarova
episodes.summary: Karim returns to the house with reinforcements, OA tries to access Nina's memories, and Hap offers to discharge Scott -- after one last experiment.

episodes.title: Chapter 8: Overview
episodes.summary: While BBA and the others converge on the clinic, Nina persuades Hap to show her his research, and Karim unlocks one of the house's final secrets.
